# Manual pages are overstruck (a character, a backspace, that character again).
# col -bx keeps the last character in each column. Without col, sed deletes the
# character before each backspace; the user locale makes "." one character.
tool_man() {
  local page section offset limit out rc line text= lineno=0 shown=0 bytes=0 more=
  local bs=$'\b' err paths rest path dir sec shown_sec others seen=
  local -a margs
  jget page || jget name
  page=$REPLY
  jget section
  section=$REPLY
  jget offset
  int_arg "$REPLY" 1
  offset=$REPLY
  jget limit
  int_arg "$REPLY" "$MAX_LINES"
  limit=$REPLY
  ((offset < 1)) && offset=1
  ((limit < 1 || limit > MAX_LINES)) && limit=$MAX_LINES
  [[ -n $page ]] || { tool_fail "page is required"; return; }
  case $page in
    . | .. | -* | *[!A-Za-z0-9._+:@-]*)
      [[ $page == '[' || $page == ']' ]] || { tool_fail "page must be a manual name such as printf or git-commit"; return; }
      ;;
  esac
  ((${#page} > 128)) && { tool_fail "page must be a manual name such as printf or git-commit"; return; }
  case $section in
    '' | [nNlL] | [0-9]*)
      case $section in
        *[!0-9A-Za-z]*) tool_fail "section must be a manual section such as 1, 3, or 3p"; return ;;
      esac
      ((${#section} > 6)) && { tool_fail "section must be a manual section such as 1, 3, or 3p"; return; }
      ;;
    *) tool_fail "section must be a manual section such as 1, 3, or 3p"; return ;;
  esac
  command -v man >/dev/null 2>&1 || { tool_fail "man is not installed"; return; }
  margs=(-P cat)
  [[ -n $section ]] && margs+=("$section")
  margs+=("$page")
  out=$SHY_TMP/man.$RANDOM$RANDOM
  (
    locale_user
    export MANPAGER=cat PAGER=cat MANWIDTH=80 GROFF_NO_SGR=1
    set -o pipefail
    if command -v col >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      command man "${margs[@]}" | command col -bx
    else
      command man "${margs[@]}" | command sed "s/.${bs}//g"
    fi
  ) >"$out" 2>"$out.err" &
  spin_wait $! "reading"
  rc=$?
  if [[ -n $INTERRUPTED ]]; then
    rm -f "$out" "$out.err"
    tool_fail "Interrupted by user"
    return
  fi
  if [[ ! -s $out ]]; then
    IFS= read -r err <"$out.err"
    rm -f "$out" "$out.err"
    if [[ -z $err ]]; then
      if [[ -n $section ]]; then err="No manual entry for $page in section $section"; else err="No manual entry for $page"; fi
    else
      oneline "$err" 300
      err=$REPLY
    fi
    tool_fail "$err"
    return
  fi
  paths=$(
    locale_user
    command man -aw "$page" 2>/dev/null
  ) || true
  shown_sec=$section
  rest=$paths
  while [[ -n $rest ]]; do
    path=${rest%%$'\n'*}
    if [[ $path == "$rest" ]]; then rest=; else rest=${rest:${#path}+1}; fi
    dir=${path%/*}
    sec=${dir##*/}
    case $sec in
      man*) sec=${sec#man} ;;
      *) continue ;;
    esac
    [[ -n $sec ]] || continue
    if [[ -z $shown_sec ]]; then
      shown_sec=$sec
      continue
    fi
    [[ $sec == "$shown_sec" ]] && continue
    case ",$seen," in
      *",$sec,"*) continue ;;
    esac
    if [[ -z $seen ]]; then seen=$sec; else seen+=", $sec"; fi
  done
  others=$seen
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
    lineno=$((lineno + 1))
    ((lineno < offset)) && continue
    if ((shown >= limit || bytes + ${#line} + 1 > MAX_BYTES)); then
      more=1
      break
    fi
    text+=$line$'\n'
    shown=$((shown + 1))
    bytes=$((bytes + ${#line} + 1))
  done <"$out"
  rm -f "$out" "$out.err"
  if ((shown == 0)); then
    if [[ -n $more ]]; then
      utf8_head "${line:0:MAX_BYTES}"
      text="$REPLY"$'\n\n'"[Line $lineno is longer than 50KB and was cut.]"
      TOOL_INFO="1 partial line"
    elif ((lineno == 0)); then
      text="(empty manual page)"
      TOOL_INFO=$text
    else
      text="Offset $offset is past the end of the page ($lineno lines)."
      TOOL_INFO=$text
    fi
  else
    if [[ -n $shown_sec ]]; then TOOL_INFO="$page($shown_sec) · $shown lines"; else TOOL_INFO="$page · $shown lines"; fi
    if [[ -n $more ]]; then
      text+=$'\n'"[Showing lines $offset-$((offset + shown - 1)). More lines follow; use offset=$((offset + shown)) to continue.]"
    fi
  fi
  [[ -n $others ]] && text+=$'\n'"[Other sections: $others. Pass section to read one of them.]"
  TOOL_OUT=$text
}

test_one() {
  local sh=$1 label=$2
  echo "======== $label ========"
  "$sh" -c '
    source "$1"
    setup
    SHY_TMP=$(mktemp -d)
    fail=0
    check() {
      local name=$1 expect=$2
      json_parse "$3" || { echo "PARSE FAIL $name"; fail=1; return; }
      TOOL_OUT= TOOL_FAILED= TOOL_INFO=
      tool_man
      local got=ok
      [[ -n $TOOL_FAILED ]] && got=fail
      if [[ $got != "$expect" ]]; then echo "FAIL $name expected $expect got $got: ${TOOL_FAILED:-} info=${TOOL_INFO}"; fail=1; return; fi
      echo "OK $name :: ${TOOL_FAILED:-${TOOL_INFO}}"
    }
    has() {
      local name=$1 needle=$2
      case $TOOL_OUT in
        *"$needle"*) echo "OK $name contains [$needle]" ;;
        *) echo "FAIL $name missing [$needle]"; echo "$TOOL_OUT" | head -20; fail=1 ;;
      esac
    }
    lacks() {
      local name=$1 needle=$2
      case $TOOL_OUT in
        *"$needle"*) echo "FAIL $name unexpectedly has [$needle]"; fail=1 ;;
        *) echo "OK $name lacks [$needle]" ;;
      esac
    }
    check req fail "{}"
    check badpage fail "{\"page\":\"foo/bar\"}"
    check dash fail "{\"page\":\"-k\"}"
    check dot fail "{\"page\":\".\"}"
    check badsec fail "{\"page\":\"printf\",\"section\":\"1;rm\"}"
    check longsec fail "{\"page\":\"printf\",\"section\":\"1234567\"}"
    check oksec3posix fail "{\"page\":\"printf\",\"section\":\"3posix\"}"
    check printf ok "{\"page\":\"printf\"}"
    has printf "formatted output"
    has printf "Other sections:"
    has printf "3"
    printf "%s" "$TOOL_OUT" | od -An -tx1 | grep -q " 08 " && { echo "FAIL backspace in printf"; fail=1; } || echo "OK no backspace"
    left=$(find "$SHY_TMP" -type f | wc -l | tr -d " ")
    [[ $left == 0 ]] && echo "OK temp cleaned" || { echo "FAIL temp files $left"; fail=1; }
    check sec3 ok "{\"page\":\"printf\",\"section\":\"3\"}"
    has sec3 "printf"
    has sec3 "Other sections:"
    case $TOOL_INFO in
      *"printf(3)"*) echo "OK info section 3: $TOOL_INFO" ;;
      *) echo "FAIL info: $TOOL_INFO"; fail=1 ;;
    esac
    check namealias ok "{\"name\":\"ls\",\"limit\":5}"
    has namealias "LS(1)"
    has namealias "More lines follow"
    check bracket ok "{\"page\":\"[\",\"limit\":8}"
    has bracket "test"
    check open2 ok "{\"page\":\"open\",\"section\":\"2\",\"limit\":12}"
    has open2 "open"
    check missing fail "{\"page\":\"nosuchpagexyz\"}"
    check past ok "{\"page\":\"printf\",\"offset\":99999}"
    has past "past the end"
    check bashpage ok "{\"page\":\"bash\",\"limit\":30}"
    has bashpage "BASH"
    # schema
    json_parse "[$TOOLS_ALL]" && echo "OK tools json" || { echo "FAIL tools json"; fail=1; }
    # summary line via run_tool
    run_tool man "{\"page\":\"true\",\"section\":\"1\",\"limit\":3}" 0 >/tmp/shy-man-ui.txt
    echo "UI: $(head -1 /tmp/shy-man-ui.txt)"
    case $TOOL_INFO in
      true\(1\)*) echo "OK run_tool info $TOOL_INFO" ;;
      *) echo "FAIL run_tool info $TOOL_INFO"; fail=1 ;;
    esac
    rm -rf "$SHY_TMP"
    exit $fail
  ' _ "$src"
  echo "exit $?"
}

content.text:
The `man` tool is now part of `shy.sh`. It looks up a manual page and returns plain text, so the agent does not have to run `man` through the bash tool and fight the pager.

It takes a page name, an optional section (`1`, `2`, `3`, `3p`, and so on), and the same `offset` and `limit` paging as `read`. Output stops at 2000 lines or 50KB. Overstrike formatting is removed, and when a name exists in more than one section the result says which other sections are available. A missing page or a section that does not exist comes back as an error instead of a different page.
